### (d) Needs human eyeball
- Judge spend: the estimate gate binds pre-dispatch, but the realized need-set size (eval union ∪ top_pairs ctx ∪ receipts in-edges) is unknown until the pod mining lands. W1 items are heavy (~25 prompts + 20 negatives ≈ 20K tokens/item); if need ≈ 5,000 features the upper bound approaches the $300 default cap — the gate will refuse and the orchestrator descopes or raises --budget-usd deliberately.
- Smoke stand-ins (deviations #3): the 940 MB banked answer-SAE fetch and the 143 MB banked refit fetch first execute on the pod (schema asserts fire immediately after load). Recommend the experimenter run the pod-side `--phase smoke` first (launcher does this in --full).
- Compute: est. 4-6 GPU-h (brief). Dominant walls at production shape: fp64 eigh at d_live≤32,768 + two fp64 half-solves; fp32 GEMMs run under TF32 (deviations #7). Not smoke-timeable at production shape on this VM; the experimenter should watch map_ridge_full/edges walls vs the 4-6 h envelope.
